title: Forex News Trading EA
entry_long: Market open in specified time windows (Monday-Friday per Forex Factory news schedule); detect price impulse +5 pips within 4 seconds
entry_short: Mirror of long: opening time windows + downside impulse 5 pips within 4 seconds
exit: Trailing stop 500 pips/step 100, no SL, no TP; close manually or at news event end
buildon_idea: Add position cap (max 10-15 orders); add TP threshold; test with spread stress (news volatility spike)
novelty_note: News-calendar integration with simple momentum detection; medium novelty

title: Close First Order and Early Profit (v2)
entry_long: EMA5 crosses above EMA12 at candle ID3; distance check (EMA5-EMA12 > 3 pips); then open 1st trade @ market
entry_short: Mirror: EMA5 crosses below EMA12 + distance check
exit: Close first order when cumulative profit (order1 loss + profitable orders 2..15) > 30 pips via for-loop aggregation
buildon_idea: Already capped at 30; flat-lot baseline test first; convert to log-lot for risk reduction; test MC with position-cap variance
novelty_note: Orders capped + profit-pooling close (not individual); low novelty but solid mechanics

title: Close First Order and Early Profit (v4 - Escalation)
entry_long: RSI < 30 (oversold) + prior candle doji + EMA alignment; enter on reversal signal (bullish engulfing)
entry_short: RSI > 70 (overbought) + prior candle doji + enter on bearish engulfing
exit: Cumulative profit check (order1 + profitable subset) >= close_money (500 pips) OR cumulative hit TP
buildon_idea: Escalation sequence (1,2,3...10 on profit) is linear; replace with log-lot; add final TP line; cap at 20 not 30
novelty_note: Doji filter + RSI overbought/oversold pre-filter + linear escalation on profit reset; medium novelty

title: Adjust Lot Size Based on Equity Percentage
entry_long: EMA5 > EMA12 + distance > 3 pips; adjust lot by equity zone (90%+ → 0.1L, 80-90% → 0.2L, 70-80% → 0.4L, <70% → 0.8L)
entry_short: EMA5 < EMA12 + distance > 3 pips; same equity-based lot scaling
exit: TP 20 pips; if intermediate profit >= 500 pips early close allowed
buildon_idea: Equity zones are crude; add ATR-based SL; test correlation between zone-switches and drawdown phases
novelty_note: Equity % zones for lot sizing (not dd); common risk mgmt pattern

title: Custom Sequence and Reversal Candle Pattern
entry_long: Candle ID3=bearish body≥20pips, ID1/ID2=bullish body≥10pips reversal → buy
entry_short: Candle ID3=bullish body≥20pips, ID1/ID2=bearish body≥10pips reversal → sell
exit: SL 50 pips, TP 100 pips (or custom modes per input)
buildon_idea: Sequence is uncapped (no hard stop after step 10); add absolute cap (max 5x base or 0.5 lot ceiling); test on higher TF (H4)
novelty_note: Fibonacci-adjacent odd-number escalation; simple pattern but no position limit

title: Liquidity and Inducement Trap Detection
entry_long: 3 consecutive down candles (body_sum≥45pips) + reversal (up candles ID1/ID2) + signal line cross → buy at trap point minus 1 pip
entry_short: 3 consecutive up candles (body_sum≥45pips) + reversal (down candles ID1/ID2) + signal line cross → sell at trap point plus 1 pip
exit: TP at trap reversal line (offset -0.001 for buy); SL 0.004 points (~40 pips on EURUSD); grid 5 pips
buildon_idea: Fixed lot only; test with 2x lot on second entry; add time-decay filter (close if no movement 4h)
novelty_note: Detects trap setups via body-size accumulation; avoids trap execution zone; clever risk management

title: Liquidity and Inducement Trap (v1 Revision)
entry_long: 3 consecutive impulse candles (down, body_sum≥20pips) + reversal pattern + grid 5pips → buy; close before trap resistance -10pips
entry_short: 3 consecutive impulse candles (up, body_sum≥20pips) + reversal pattern + grid 5pips → sell; close before trap support +10pips
exit: Close early (10pips before trap zone) to avoid reversal back into trap; SL 0.004 (~40pips)
buildon_idea: Fixed 0.1L; add equity-based scaling (larger lot if equity>90%); backtest 2023-2025 to verify trap-avoidance outperforms
novelty_note: Explicitly exits before trap (not at trap peak); low-drawdown design for 2023+ volatile market

title: Triple Check (3-Indicator Confluence)
entry_long: Reversal candle (ID3 down, ID1/ID2 up, body≥2pips) + price > EMA250 + Stochastic signal line crosses above 30 → buy
entry_short: Reversal candle (ID3 up, ID1/ID2 down, body≥2pips) + price < EMA250 + Stochastic signal line crosses below 70 → sell
exit: TP as sum of pips across all open positions; early close if profit >= close_money (15 pips per candle); cut-loss if drawdown > 30% of balance
buildon_idea: 3-indicator filter is strong; add MC test on hold period variance; test correlation of EMA250 zone (trend filter) with RSI added
novelty_note: Simple multi-confirmation (reversal+trend+momentum); low false-signal; equity-based dynamic cut-loss novel for this series
